en.headline: Nepalese bartenders pack Central bar for Nepal flood relief fundraiser
en.dek: About 100 patrons gathered at Orchard on Monday night as five Nepalese operators and staff served signature cocktails, with all sales going to the Nepal government’s disaster relief appeal.
body: Around a hundred people packed the Central cocktail bar Orchard on Monday evening for a fundraiser supporting victims of the flash floods and mudslides that struck the Nepal-Tibet border last week.

Five Nepalese operators and bartenders from Orchard and three other venues teamed up to create signature drinks dedicated to their homeland. The event began at 7pm; organisers said 100 per cent of sales from the night would be donated to the Government of Nepal’s Ministry of Home Affairs Official Disaster Relief Appeal.

Hong Kong is home to a Nepalese community of roughly 30,000. Chinese state media reported the death toll in Nepal had risen to 919 by Monday afternoon, with more than 4,000 people still listed as missing. The Hong Kong government has earmarked HK$50 million from the Disaster Relief Fund for the affected areas.

zh.headline: 尼泊爾籍調酒師中環酒吧籌款 支援家鄉水災災民
zh.dek: 周一晚約百名顧客到中環Orchard，五名尼泊爾籍經營者及調酒師推出特色雞尾酒，全數收益捐予尼泊爾政府賑災。
body: 周一晚中環雞尾酒吧Orchard擠滿約百名顧客，為尼泊爾與西藏邊境上周發生的山泥傾瀉及洪水災民籌款。
來自Orchard及另外三間酒吧的五名尼泊爾籍經營者及調酒師合力調製以家鄉為主題的特色雞尾酒，活動於晚上7時開始。主辦方表示當晚全數收益將捐予尼泊爾政府內政部官方賑災呼籲。
香港約有3萬名尼泊爾裔居民。中國官方媒體報道，截至周一下午尼泊爾死亡人數已升至919人，仍有逾4,000人失聯。香港政府已從賑災基金預留5,000萬元支援受影響地區。
